footnote_text: The reported transaction involved the Reporting Person's receipt of 40,000 restricted share units ("RSUs"). The RSUs were granted pursuant to the applicable RSU agreement and the Lixte Biotechnology Holdings, Inc. 2020 Stock Incentive Plan. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock upon vesting, subject to continued service. The 40,000 RSUs vested upon the achievement of the performance conditions set forth in the Reporting Person's RSU agreement, which have been satisfied. || The total reported in Column 5 includes (i) the 40,000 newly awarded RSUs, and (ii) 25,000 RSUs, all of which have vested.

On July 1, 2026, upon the closing of the merger between the Issuer and Nomad Transportable Power Systems, Inc. ("NTPS"), Access Alternative Group S.A. ("AAG"), a shareholder of NTPS, received 126,168 shares of the Issuer's common stock in exchange for its securities of NTPS. This amendment is being filed to report this acquisition, which was inadvertently omitted from the original Form 4 The Reporting Person is the beneficial owner of AAG and may be deemed to beneficially own the securities held by AAG. The Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of such securities except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein, and this report shall not be deemed an admission that the Reporting Person is the beneficial owner of such securities for purposes of Section 16 or for any other purpose.
